about: Hand-reviewed tags for every reference. Keys are a phone photo's file in public/photos-ref, or 'ref:<path>' for a file in the private villacana-reference repo. shows: area ids from data/areas.json (what the picture shows, not where the camera stood). viewpoint: ground, upper-floor, roof, aerial or map. useFor: topic ids from data/areas.json. looksAt: [x, z] map metres of the picture's main subject, and subject: a few words naming it (set them for roof shots and for photos you build from; otherwise the builder estimates a point along the heading). note: anything an agent must know before using it. Do not put API keys, signed URLs or photo metadata here: this repo is public. altitudeChecked: true means the viewpoint was confirmed from the picture although the phone altitude reads above 9 m (phone GPS altitude is often several metres out); use it only after looking at the photo.
